ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT NAME FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ESKLEP_PobierzIdFormyKontaktu' AND Type = 'FN') DROP FUNCTION CDN.ESKLEP_PobierzIdFormyKontaktu;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ESKLEP_PobierzIdFormyKontaktu (@FormaKontaktu VARCHAR(256)) RETURNS VARCHAR(36) AS BEGIN DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(36) SELECT @ID = CASE WHEN @FormaKontaktu = 'E-mail' THEN 'C56924B9-8560-6099-677A-346A4B0430B4' WHEN @FormaKontaktu = 'Telefon' THEN '8AE09577-576B-1385-30CA-99852ACE6173' WHEN @FormaKontaktu = 'Sms' THEN '62120227-59AC-41F4-B952-2859604131F5' WHEN @FormaKontaktu = 'Przesyłka' THEN '68A0BB81-2350-42E8-8985-BC3F72C9E510' END RETURN @ID END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ESKLEP_PobierzIdFormyKontaktu TO CDNRaport
